result.summary: Implemented ISS-0665: added BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT-driven statement_timeout bracket in runMigrations() and runMigrationsForSchema() in tests/integration/helpers.zig. Also added docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md section 10.2 explaining resource-constrained host remedies. zig build exits 0, error-set check clean.
